title: Predictive Dialer & AMD Engineer
full_description: About this opportunity AI Case Leads connects people hurt in accidents with personal injury law firms across the US. We’re replacing our hosted dialer with one we own, built on FreeSWITCH and Python. You’ll own answering-machine detection (AMD) and call-screening handling, working alongside the engineer building our dialing engine. The goal is simple: stop losing live conversations when a phone’s screening assistant answers first. What you’ll build • Detect live people, voicemail, call screeners, and silence from the first seconds of call audio. • When a screener answers, play a truthful message with our name and reason for calling, then connect a live rep when the person picks up. Route voicemail to the right message drop. • Work with our dialing engineer on pacing, abandoned-call controls, SIP/media handling, and CRM reporting. • Build a labeled set of real call audio and test every detection change against it. Track accuracy by result, phone type, and campaign, with particular attention to live people incorrectly classified as machines. Required experience • Hands-on work with iPhone call screening, including test calls to real iPhones. • Personally built or deeply extended a production predictive dialer, including pacing logic. Vendor API integration, administration, or agent-interface work alone is not enough. • Improved and measured AMD in production, beyond enabling a vendor setting. • At least 2 years of production experience with FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, Kamailio, or OpenSIPS. • Ability to read SIP traces and troubleshoot RTP, audio, and carrier issues. • Experience using speech-to-text, audio features, or machine learning to classify real call audio. • Ability to ship production backend services. Our stack is Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, and React/TypeScript. Nice to have • Experience at a dialer or contact-center software company. • FreeSWITCH module development in C or Lua, including mod_avmd. • Low-latency speech-to-text and English/Spanish voicemail drops. • Familiarity with TCPA, DNC scrubbing, STIR/SHAKEN, and caller ID reputation. Role details • Remote, full-time contract on a 12+ month roadmap. • At least 4 hours of overlap with US Central time. • Payment biweekly or monthly in arrears via Wise, Payoneer, or wire. • NDA and full IP assignment required. Code and accounts stay in our name; lead data stays in our systems. How to apply Complete the application below with your résumé, LinkedIn profile, and specific examples of your own work. We review the written answers, then invite strong applicants to a camera-on walkthrough of their telephony work and code. The final step is a short paid work sample on test call audio.

Working closely with our AI Research and Product Team to adopt established patterns and infrastructure, you will take those patterns and deliver real agentic capability - from natural language interfaces over client data to AI-assisted compensation benchmarking workflows. The ideal candidate pairs strong Python and backend API development skills with genuine hands-on experience building agentic AI systems and has the technical leadership maturity to give direction to experienced engineers, and own delivery end to end. Design and build production-grade AI agents using agentic frameworks (initially LangGraph/LangChain, with other frameworks adopted as the space evolves, including exploration of Claude Agent SDK in sandbox environments), integrating with existing platform APIs to deliver intelligent, context-aware features. Develop and maintain Python-based backend services (such as FastAPI) that expose agent capabilities via REST and server-sent event (SSE) streaming endpoints. Implement secure agent pipelines that correctly propagate user identity and entitlements, ensuring agent behaviour is scoped to individual client subscriptions. Apply a strong understanding of AI-specific security concerns - including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, agent behaviour risks, and reputational exposure - to design agents that are robust and trustworthy in a production enterprise environment. Integrate AI agents with Azure cloud services and internal platform APIs, following established architectural patterns set by the AI Research and Product Team. Instrument agent runs with structured logging, tracing, and observability tooling to support debugging, performance monitoring, and regression prevention. Collaborate closely with the HCA platform team in an agile delivery environment - helping steer and contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and ceremonies. Work alongside the AI Research and Product Team during onboarding and early delivery, absorbing patterns and progressively taking on more independent ownership of agent design decisions. Proactively communicate blockers, unknowns, and design questions - particularly when working at the frontier of rapidly evolving AI tooling. Stay current with the fast-moving AI engineering landscape; evaluate new frameworks, models, and patterns and bring relevant developments back to the team. Skills/Competencies Required 8+ years of overall software development experience, including at least 4 years in Python and backend API development, together with a track record of technical leadership - leading delivery, mentoring engineers, or owning significant systems. Substantial, demonstrable hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-powered systems. Given how new this space is, we value depth of capability over years in a formal AI title. Proven ability to give technical direction to strong, experienced engineers and to run delivery autonomously, making sound decisions independently and knowing when to align with the wider team. Solid understanding of agentic AI concepts and patterns: Tool use, state management, and multi-step reasoning Checkpointing, human-in-the-loop flows, and agent interrupts Multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns Hands-on experience with agentic or LLM frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Claude Agent SDK, or similar); formal professional experience is a plus but demonstrable hands-on capability - including personal projects and sandbox work - is equally valued. Good understanding of authentication and authorisation patterns (JWT, OAuth2, OIDC) and how to propagate user identity and entitlements securely through an agentic pipeline. Awareness of AI-specific security risks including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, and agent behaviour vulnerabilities - and how to design against them. Experience with observability practices in backend systems: structured logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring; familiarity with AI-specific evaluation and tracing concepts (e.g. MLflow, LangSmith, or similar) is a strong advantage. Experience with containerisation (Docker) for packaging and deploying backend services. Comfortable using AI coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor) as part of a day-to-day development workflow. Comfortable leading delivery in an agile environment and setting the pace for iterative, dependable execution. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills; proactive in surfacing blockers, unknowns, and design questions across teams and time zones. Genuine curiosity and drive for self-directed learning in a fast-moving technical space. Preferred / Good-to-Have Hands-on experience with LangGraph and/or LangChain in a production or near-production context. Experience with AWS cloud services (ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, S3). Familiarity with PostgreSQL and async database access patterns (psycopg3, SQLAlchemy, or similar). Experience with agent evaluation frameworks and experiment tracking (MLflow, Databricks Agents, or equivalent). Prior experience building AI features within enterprise SaaS platforms or data-heavy products. Experience applying machine learning techniques to scientific, engineering, or industrial problems. Strong interest in sensors, instrumentation, hardware systems, robotics, or other technologies that bridge software with physical-world applications. full_description: We are hiring our in-house engineer to design and build our own AI customer acquisition platform from scratch. We receive a high volume of customer enquiries every day and hold a large database of past leads. We want our sales and specialist teams to spend their time with customers, not on chasing leads. You will build one connected platform with these parts: 1. Customer CRM: our own system for leads, customers, pipeline stages, tasks and a full history of every call and message. It replaces our current CRM, and you will migrate our existing data. 2. Booking engine: appointments across locations, staff and time slots, with reminders and rescheduling. 3. AI WhatsApp agent: replies to new enquiries within 60 seconds, 24/7, answers common questions, qualifies leads and books appointments. 4. AI voice agent: calls new leads within 5 minutes with a natural Irish/UK English voice, books live on the call, and hands over to a human when needed. 5. Nurture and reactivation: follow-up sequences over weeks or months, and consent-checked campaigns to past leads. 6. Ad tracking and dashboards: tracking from ad click to booked appointment, with cost per lead and per booking by channel. 7. Later phase: an AI creative studio that produces and tests adverts across social platforms. The first milestone is a pilot covering lead response, WhatsApp, voice and booking on live enquiries. Key responsibilities Design the overall architecture so the CRM, booking, WhatsApp, voice and ad tracking all share one customer record. Build the platform end to end: database, back end, APIs and staff-facing web app. Build and tune AI agents using LLMs (e.g. Claude, GPT, Gemini): prompts, tool calling, guardrails and automated testing of conversations. Migrate our data out of our current CRM, remove duplicates and check consent records. Integrate Meta, Google and TikTok ad platforms for lead capture and conversion tracking. Build in GDPR and EU AI Act compliance: EU hosting, encryption, role-based access, audit trails, consent and AI disclosure. Give our staff a dashboard to review conversations, pause agents and edit scripts. Set up testing, monitoring, backups and alerts, and prepare for an independent penetration test. Choose and manage third-party providers and keep running costs under control. Report progress weekly and explain technical decisions in plain English. Hands-on, production experience building with LLM APIs: prompting, tool/function calling, structured outputs, guardrails and evaluation. Secure handling of personal data: encryption, role-based access, audit logs and GDPR principles. Excellent written and spoken English. AI image or video generation tools. Experience leading or mentoring other developers. Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor).
